blocks.text: Nylon is a synthetic polyamide, formed by condensation polymerisation, usually from two different monomers: a diamine, H2N-R-NH2, and a dicarboxylic acid, HOOC-R'-COOH; a small molecule, usually water, is removed. Nylon-6,6 is the most common example: it is made from hexane-1,6-diamine and hexanedioic acid, each with six carbon atoms: n H2N-(CH2)6-NH2 + n HOOC-(CH2)4-COOH -> [-NH-(CH2)6-NH-CO-(CH2)4-CO-]n + 2n H2O.

Nylon-6 is formed from a single monomer, caprolactam, which has a cyclic structure; it is named nylon-6 because the monomer has six carbon atoms. The ring opens to give [-NH-(CH2)5-CO-]n. The reaction is not a typical condensation, because no small molecule is removed, but nylon-6 is classed as a condensation polymer because of the way its amide links form. The book describes nylon-6 as giving a smoother surface and higher impact resistance than nylon-6,6, and as easier to mould because its melting point is lower; it is used in rollers, skateboard wheels and power-tool handles.

blocks.alt: Top: hexane-1,6-diamine + hexanedioic (adipic) acid give [-NH-(CH2)6-NH-CO-(CH2)4-CO-]n + 2n H2O; six carbons in each monomer, hence 6,6. Bottom: the seven-membered caprolactam ring (one N, a C=O) opens to give nylon-6, [-NH-(CH2)5-CO-]n, with no small molecule removed.
blocks.caption: Formation of nylon-6,6 and nylon-6 (original diagram after the book's schemes).
blocks.long_description: Nylon-6,6 alternates a six-carbon diamine unit and a six-carbon diacid unit joined by amide links. In nylon-6 every repeat unit comes from the same six-carbon caprolactam molecule, whose ring amide bond opens and joins up with the next molecule.

blocks.prompt: The repeating unit of nylon-6,10 is -NH-(CH2)6-NH-CO-(CH2)8-CO-. What are its monomers?
blocks.explanation: Hexane-1,6-diamine, H2N-(CH2)6-NH2, and decanedioic acid, HOOC-(CH2)8-COOH (or its dioyl chloride, ClOC-(CH2)8-COCl).

blocks.prompt: The monomers of nylon-6,4 are H2N(CH2)6NH2 and HOOC(CH2)2COOH. Give the repeating unit.

items: Nylon-6,6: hexane-1,6-diamine + hexanedioic acid; water lost.
Nylon-6: ring-opening of caprolactam; no small molecule lost.
